comment: The contract between server/src/fireworks.ts (prices, requirements) and roblox/src/shared/FireworkCatalog.luau (recipes). Both sides' tests assert they cover every id here, so a shell that can be sold but not drawn is a CI failure rather than a blank sky.
mortarsComment: The gear-required subset of `shells` and the mortar tier each needs to fire muzzle-true. Every OTHER shell in `shells` (firecracker, ishibana) requires no gear. Both server/src/fireworks.ts's REQUIREMENTS and roblox/src/shared/MortarPlacement.luau's SHELL_MORTAR are asserted against this list, in both directions, so one side changing a shell's gear tier without the other is a CI failure, not a silent muzzle-origin drift.
